name: stavovy-radek
description: Status band above the prompt: model, context fill, prompt cache countdown, 5-hour and weekly limits (numbers from the app), project, worktree, a compact button and an optional safeguard that compacts an idle window before its cache goes cold

guard.title: Safeguard before the cache goes cold
guard.description: What happens to an idle window whose prompt cache is about to run out: off (nothing), compact (run /compact), flush-then-compact (send the flush text first, run /compact after that turn). Never acts when the cache lifetime is under 30 minutes.

flushText.title: Flush text
flushText.description: The message sent as your own before the compact in flush-then-compact mode (for example a request to save progress notes). Unused in the other modes.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache lives after the last activity: 60 on subscriptions, 5 on API-key sessions. The warning colours scale with it.

language.title: Language of the labels
language.description: Language of the words on the band (week, turn running, cache cold, compacting).
